reason: The README clearly describes a plugin for publishing and updating articles on three external blogging platforms, with an auxiliary technology-news retrieval tool and cookie-based authentication.

summaries.zh: 在会话中将 Markdown 文章发布或更新到 CSDN、掘金和博客园，并可获取科技资讯作为写作素材。
summaries.en: Publishes or updates Markdown articles on CSDN, Juejin, and CNBlog, and can fetch technology news as writing material.

capabilities: Publishes or updates Markdown articles on CSDN, Juejin, and CNBlog
Retrieves a technology news item from a blog RSS feed
Uses configured platform cookies and tokens to authenticate requests
Uploads or proxies external article images for CSDN publishing
